Almiraj.name: Almiraj
Almiraj.publicNotes:
An almiraj closely resembles a yellow hare in almost all ways... except for the 2-pies-long black horn jutting from its forehead. Though it shares this rasgo with the docile unicorn, that's where their similarities end. Almirajes are vicious criaturas, known to slaughter much larger cattle and, in times of desperation, people. Its stare is said to send even the bravest warrior running for their life.

Unlike common hares, almirajes are solitary and intensely territorial. They're adaptable ambush hunters with the stamina and speed to chase down any prey. They attack with their jaws and claws but are primarily known for trying to gut their prey with a vicious stab from their horn. Many scholars believe that the terrifying magical aura the criaturas exude originates from their horns. Este line of thinking has led to an increase in almiraj attacks as local citizens try to capture the criatura alive and remove the horn, hoping this will turn it into a more docile hare. Estos hopes have not proven fruitful, as an almiraj is just as aggressive, if not more so, after their horn has been removed.

Adventurers often think themselves lucky if they manage to avoid the terrifying horn of this ferocious predator, but it's a much better alternative than being caught in its jaws. Almirajes have a nasty habit of grabbing their prey and vigorously shaking them until they go limp. If this fails, they'll drag their prey underground until they suffocate deep in the earth. Few have ever escaped the burrow of an almiraj.

Apothecary Bee.name: Apothecary Bee
Apothecary Bee.publicNotes:
Estos giant bees feed on the nectar of medicinal herbs and magical flowers, naturally processing the liquid into syrupy-sweet potions. Depending on the precise diet of the apothecary bees, they can produce a wide variety of potions, storing any excess in the waxy cells lining their nest. Apothecary bee workers are about a pies long, with yellow and black stripes. While carrying a potion, the bee's abdomen visibly swells and often changes color to match the potion within.

The value of the apothecary bees' potions has led to numerous attempts at domestication, a dangerous, expensive dream with both high risks and high rewards. Once a magical garden has been established, apothecary beehives tend to become self-sustaining. Beekeepers can potentially guide their cultivation, but they're no longer necessary for the hive's SURVIVAL. Some ancient, long-abandoned gardens still grow along the Sphinx River in Osirion, where many apothecary bees prowl for flowers that meet their standards. Upon their most recent dig to the surface, surki communities quickly began the process of "trading" with the bees, establishing habitats and using their natural magic sense to better tend the massive fields a large hive needs. Miflits, on the other hand, often end up absorbed into the bees' social structure.

The potions a hive produces vary from season to season, depending on what flowers are available. Beekeepers have made strides in creating gardens that yield specific potions and have even developed harvesting techniques that increase potion effectiveness. Estos techniques are valuable, closely guarded secrets, but even defective potions with cursed results have found use among the followers of Calistria and Norgorber.

Ascendant Griffon.name: Ascendant Griffon
Ascendant Griffon.publicNotes: Este griffon is aptly named for both its majestic appearance in flight and its increased ferocity over the common griffon. Despite its size, the sheer muscle mass present in this criatura makes flight seem effortless, if preposterous. It makes its home among the canopies of the most ancient forests and atop the peaks of the greatest mountains, hunting its prey from above with silent and deadly accuracy. The ascendant griffon prefers to hunt other large criaturas within its territory, such as bears, but they will not hesitate to attack smaller prey they perceive as a threat to their territory. Whether an ascendant griffon is a new evolutionary development or a throwback to a more primeval version of the criatura is difficult to determine. Further research into these exceptional criaturas may provide insight into their origins and perhaps the origins of all griffons.

Barded Manticore.name: Barded Manticore
Barded Manticore.publicNotes:
Barded manticores are treacherous and dangerous beasts, and the only known member of the manticore species with the innate ability to cast conjuros. Luckily, these criaturas are incredibly rare, mostly found near battlefields and other sources of worked metal, though stories tell of a particularly clever barded manticore attempting to make herself a home deep under the Magaambya.

Unlike the other members of the species, a barded manticore has a face that resembles a human's and a torso coated in scales of varying metals, the exact composition depending on their diet. Thanks to these materials, most barded manticores are able to fend off just about any being attempting to encroach upon their territories, especially fiends and other criaturas with weaknesses to specific metals. Barded manticores sift through metals obtained from their victims, whether that be local villagers coerced into giving them tribute or unlucky travelers, and seek the rarest, most valuable types to make part of their next meals.

Este also includes armor and armas inscribed with runes that grant a barded manticore the ability to cast conjuros, though these conjuros vary depending on the region the beast inhabits and what type of runes they consume. In rare areas where magic is suppressed, a barded manticore will be unable to grow their runed scales, rendering them less powerful than others of their kind. Pointing this out to such a barded manticore often ends in one's untimely demise at the manticore's claws and spines, no less sharp for the lack of enchantments.

Chaos Falcon.name: Chaos Falcon
Chaos Falcon.publicNotes:
The extreme weather that gives birth to chaos falcons grants them a mix of abilities not found in other elemental birds. To them, lightning is as natural as fire and heat as comfortable as cold. The variability of their attacks makes them dangerous, even for the well prepared.

Like their elemental cousins, chaos falcons are often the harbingers of storms. They're also seen as omens of volcanic activity, as they will travel across great distances to play and dance in the resulting eruption. Between this association and their tendency to rain both fire and ice, their presence is considered dangerous by nearby settlements.

Fortunately, chaos falcons are solitary birds that prefer to stay away from the noise of civilization. They nest in volcanic vents or areas with geothermal activity, relying on the heat of the earth to incubate their eggs while hunting in the wilderness nearby. Unless their peace is disrupted or their safety threatened, they're unlikely to attack criaturas that move through their habitat.

Crying Cicada.name: Crying Cicada
Crying Cicada.publicNotes:
Estos small insects are a nuisance and danger to small villages within Brevoy, taking over entire forests and blending in with the foliage. Also known as calling beetles, due to their ability to mimic and repeat the voices of their previous victims, crying cicadas wait for passersby to lure into the trees, fascinating their victims with their cries before fluttering their wings to release toxic dust. Once a target is near death, crying cicadas will take flight from the trees and land on the body to feed.

The scale dust of crying cicadas can be turned into an effective ingested poison, but obtaining a cicada and harvesting these scales is so dangerous that most would-be poisoners simply die in the process. Even finding the insects is dangerous enough; crying cicadas' natural STEALTH and dark coloration make them difficult to locate among the trees of a forest, and following their cries often leads one to fall victim to the very criaturas they're hunting.

The longer a colony of crying cicadas stays in a forest, the wider their collection of cries grows. Often, a young colony will be able to replicate only the sounds of small, dying criaturas, but larger, more established colonies will have the ability to mimic the sounds of children and dragons.

action->Steal Voice.name: Robar voz
action->Steal Voice.description:
Requisitos Un enemigo criatura has spoken since the crying cicada's last turn

Efecto The crying cicada learns and mimics the sound of its opponent's voice. It can't make new sentences, but it can elige to repeat select parts of the phrases it has heard. All non-cicada criaturas within 30 pies, other than the owner of the stolen voice, must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:19] save to disbelieve the mimicry.

action->Wings Flat.name: Wings Flat
action->Wings Flat.description: When the crying cicada is still and perched on a tree, it blends seamlessly into the environment. It has an automatic result of 30 on DECEPTION checks and DCs to pass as part of the tree.

action->Crying Cicada Poison.name: Crying Cicada Poison
action->Crying Cicada Poison.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:19]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] daño plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 daño de veneno plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]] daño plus ralentizado 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} (1 round).

action->Sob.name: Sob
action->Sob.description:
The crying cicada mimics the noise of a wounded animal or crying child. Non-cicada criaturas within a @Template[emanation|distance:150] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:19] save or be distressed by the pleas for help. The effect lasts for 1 round, but if the cicada uses this ability again on subsequent rounds, it extends the duration by 1 round for all affected criaturas. Once a criatura succeeds at any save against Sob, that criatura is temporarily immune to Sob for 24 hours.

Éxito The criatura is unaffected.

Fallo The criatura believes an animal or child needs help somewhere nearby. The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinado}, and it must spend each of its actions to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or move closer to the cicada as expediently as possible, while avoiding obvious dangers. If the criatura is adjacent to the cicada, it stays still and doesn't act.

action->Wing Flurry.name: Wing Flurry
action->Wing Flurry.description: The crying cicada beats its wings together, exposing all criaturas within a @Template[burst|distance:10] to crying cicada poison.

Decapod Dinghy.name: Decapod Dinghy
Decapod Dinghy.publicNotes:
Decapod dinghies are massive crabs indigenous to the Okaiyo Ocean that often assist the local humanoids with transportation. They can understand Thalassic and are instantly recognizable by the colorful anemones they carry on their backs and in their front claws. Athamarus and merfolk are common sights atop decapod dinghies, lounging comfortably amidst the anemones and sharing food with their hosts.

Este peaceful cooperation is indirectly caused by the legendario crustacean Tehialai-Thief-Of-Ships. Since Tehialai's rampages are a constant threat in the Okaiyo, the ancestors of the decapod dinghies bonded with other marine life to survive. Decapod dinghies' relationship with anemones is particularly tight, using the small criaturas as poisonous extensions of their own bodies and using their response to movements in the water to compensate for the decapod dinghy's otherwise poor vision. In a region wracked by Tehialai's storms, everyone needs to band together, after all.

action->All Aboard.name: All Aboard
action->All Aboard.description: A decapod dinghy can carry up to 30 Bulk of criaturas or unattended items on their back, such as five Medium criaturas. The anemones' gentle hold on the passengers is sufficient in most situations, but while in combat, those passengers are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} if they want to take other actions while remaining on the decapod dinghy's back.

action->Anemone Transport.name: Anemone Transport
action->Anemone Transport.description: The decapod dinghy and all their willing passengers teleport to a patch of anemones within 10 miles large enough for the decapod dinghy to stand among them. Although the decapod dinghy doesn't need to see the location, they must have been there before. All criaturas transported are temporarily immune to this ability for 24 hours.

action->Inflate Anemones.name: Inflate Anemones
action->Inflate Anemones.description: The anemones on the decapod dinghy's back inflate, enveloping all passengers and giving each passenger a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC until the beginning of the decapod dinghy's next turn.

action->Protect Passenger.name: Protect Passenger
action->Protect Passenger.description:
Desencadenante Un enemigo within 20 pies damages one of the decapod dinghy's passengers

Efecto The decapod dinghy's anemones lash out for a tentacle Golpe against the triggering criatura.

action->Stinging Anemones.name: Stinging Anemones
action->Stinging Anemones.description: The decapod dinghy's anemones sting any number of criaturas they elige among passengers and those the decapod dinghy has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado}. The stings deal @Damage[5d6[poison]] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:26|basic]). On a failed save, that criatura is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} for 1 hour.

Desert Manticore.name: Desert Manticore
Desert Manticore.publicNotes: desierto manticores son far more dangerous than su common cousins y solo marginally cleverer. Instead de el usually spiked cola reminiscent de un porcupine, desierto manticores tienen grande scorpion tails, requiring them a adopt closer approaches y cunning ambushes. desierto manticores son known for su egos y constant attempts a outmatch sphinxes dentro de su chosen territories. No accounts de such attempts tienen ever proved fruitful for el desierto manticore.

action->Indomitable Beast.name: Indomitable Beast
action->Indomitable Beast.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Desencadenante The desert manticore is reduced to 0 HP

Efecto The desert manticore avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 HP, then can make a stinger Golpe against a criatura in its reach.

action->Manticore Venom.name: Manticore Venom
action->Manticore Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:32]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d8[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[4d8[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[5d8[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 3} (1 round)

action->Scorpion Sting.name: Scorpion Sting
action->Scorpion Sting.description: The desert manticore Golpes an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criatura with its stinger. The attack injects venom deeply, dealing an additional 4d8 daño de veneno and giving el objetivo a –2 penalización de circunstancia to their initial save against the poison.

action->Venomous Flight.name: Venomous Flight
action->Venomous Flight.description: The desert manticore Flies twice, dripping venom from its stinger. It chooses a criatura it flew directly above during the flight, which is exposed to manticore venom. The desert manticore cannot fly further than 60 pies above el objetivo or the venom becomes too dispersed in fall to take effect.

Drthak.name: Drthak
Drthak.publicNotes:
Dischorans son un group de predators who hunt via focused sound. Though ellos possess protuberances que resemble eyes, these son actually auditory sensory organs que puede pick up even el slightest sound y son used a locate prey con pinpoint accuracy.

Only un few types de dischorans tienen been identified, but ellos todos share unifying features: front-facing pseudo-eyes, deceptive speed, y ravenous hunger. Their sensitivity a noise combined con su ability a weaponize sound son likely el primary reasons dischorans spend most de su time alone.

Drthaks son aquatic predators con long trailing fins que son rarely seen, clinging a coasts y estuaries where el high silt content makes them practically invisible a predators y prey alike. Some tienen been known a come inland, tracking su prey miles upriver before striking. El underwater environment alters el typical dischoran hunting behavior, con drthaks creating bubbles que implode a stun prey.

action->Auditory Hunter.name: Auditory Hunter
action->Auditory Hunter.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 15 pies uses an auditory action

Efecto The drthak Strides or Swims towards the criatura.

action->Deep Breath.name: Contener La Respiración
action->Deep Breath.description: El drthak puede contener la respiracion durante unas 2 horas.

action->Pull Under.name: Pull Under
action->Pull Under.description: The drthak can Swim at half Velocidad while it has a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} in its jaws, carrying the criatura along with it.

action->Sensitive Echolocation.name: Sensitive Echolocation
action->Sensitive Echolocation.description: The drthak can use its hearing as a precise sense with the listed range. If the drthak takes daño sónico beyond its resistance, its senses are overloaded and all criaturas are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} from it for 1 round.

action->Bubble Burst.name: Bubble Burst
action->Bubble Burst.description:
Requisitos The drthak is underwater

Efecto The drthak uses sonic power to push aside water in a @Template[emanation|distance:30], which then collapses in a crushing torrent. All criaturas in the area, other than the drthak, take @Damage[3d10[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:24|basic|options:area-effect] save).

action->Resonant Jaws.name: Resonant Jaws
action->Resonant Jaws.description: When the drthak misses a screech Golpe against a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} in its jaws, it deals that criatura @Damage[2d6[sonic]] daño.

Fangtooth School.name: Fangtooth School
Fangtooth School.publicNotes: The fearsome teeth of this fish are so massive that it's difficult for the criatura to close its mouth. Estos fish must consider even much larger criaturas as possible food, rising towards the surface during the darkness of night.

action->Sunless Sight.name: Sunless Sight
action->Sunless Sight.description: While in bright light, the fangtooth fish school is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1}.

action->Bite and Gnaw.name: Bite and Gnaw
action->Bite and Gnaw.description: Each enemigo in the school's space takes @Damage[2d8[piercing]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] save)

Flynkett.name: Flynkett
Flynkett.publicNotes:
The piercing whistle of the flynkett can often be heard over the harsh jungle rains, shrieking dissonantly when its cries combine with others of its pack. Although generally effective as a warning to nearby predators, these sharp cries also serve as a lure for reckless alchemists eager to study the criatura's potent enzymes.

Flynketts' name, most theorize, is a corruption of "flinging kettle" or "flying kettle." They can't truly fly, instead using their skin flaps to glide in a manner similar to flying squirrels. However, the primary use of their skin flaps isn't for movement, but digestion. When it rains, flynketts roll up their loose skin, creating a crude sort of kettle in which to catch precipitation. The remarkable criaturas' acid combines with the falling water to break down wood, soil, or even rocks into a nutritional stew. Therefore, the flynkett can flourish when introduced to any environment with frequent rain, something solid to stand on, and a lack of natural predators.

Although their acid can be harvested without harming a flynkett, the criaturas rarely cooperate. If disturbed, particularly in the middle of feeding, they release clouds of acidic steam. They're also capable of spitting the fluid with deadly accuracy. Thankfully for those who run afoul of them, flynketts have no use for corpses and will generally break off pursuit when the interloper leaves their territory.

Several organizations and individual scholars have desperately sought to domesticate flynketts for use in alchemical production. To date, none of these efforts have been successful, though several abandoned labs still contain aggressive packs of flynketts who protect their new territory with ferocious tenacity.

action->Glide.name: Glide
action->Glide.description: The flynkett stretches its flaps to glide through the air. It moves 5 pies down and up to 25 pies forward through the air. The flynkett can remain in the air long as it spends at least 1 action Gliding each round and does not Kettle Up.

action->Kettle Up.name: Kettle Up
action->Kettle Up.description: The flynkett uses its skin flaps to form a crude kettle. While Kettled Up, the flynkett can't use its claw Golpe or take move actions. If the flynkett has been Kettled Up for 1 minute or longer, and its kettle is full of water (usually due to the flynkett being in the rain), the flynkett's kettle begins to boil, emitting a piercing whistle that causes all criaturas within 30 pies to take a –2 penalización to Perception checks to hear sources other than the flynkett; this is an auditory effect. The flynkett can stop Kettling Up as a free action.

action->Spill.name: Spill
action->Spill.description:
Requisitos The flynkett is Kettled Up

Desencadenante The flynkett takes daño físico or is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}

Efecto The flynkett spills the contents of its full skin flaps, releasing its digestive juices in a cloud of acidic vapor that deals @Damage[2d8[acid]] daño to all non-flynkett criaturas within @Template[emanation|distance:20]{20 pies} (@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] save). If the flynkett was boiling, the daño is increased to @Damage[4d8[acid]].

Ghost Ape.name: Ghost Ape
Ghost Ape.publicNotes: Ghost apes are reclusive and territorial criaturas that usually reveal themselves only when their homes are threatened. Most ghost apes will first attempt to use their imposing presence and natural teleportation to frighten and confuse their foes into fleeing. Ghost apes can speak but aren't particularly talkative, though they will, on rare occasions, treat with those who approach them with respect. Ghost apes can be powerful allies when motivated by a common cause, although they tend to be suspicious of outsiders, and their trust isn't easily earned.

action->Phantom Step.name: Phantom Dar un paso
action->Phantom Step.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto The ghost ape moves quickly, passing through the Ethereal Plane. They teleport up to a distance equal to twice their Velocidad within their line of sight.

action->Ghost Stance.name: Ghost Stance
action->Ghost Stance.description: The ghost ape phases partially out of existence, its form blurring and becoming difficult to pinpoint. While in this stance, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} to any criatura that isn't adjacent to them. They can't use this concealment to Hide or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}. They also gain resistance 5 to daño físico. If the ghost ape takes daño de fuerza, this stance ends and they can't reenter it for [[/br 1d3 #rounds]]{1d3 rounds}.

action->Terrifying Display.name: Terrifying Display
action->Terrifying Display.description: The ghost ape beats their chest in a terrifying display. Las criaturas within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 pies} must succeed a @Check[will|dc:20] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2} on a critical failure). While a criatura is asustado by this ability, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to the ape. On a success, the criatura is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Giant Coppermouth.name: Giant Coppermouth
Giant Coppermouth.publicNotes: Las bocas de cobre son feroces y agresivas, incluso a solas, y confian en su veneno y en su capacidad para manipular impulsos bioelectricos.

action->Deep Breath.name: Contener La Respiración
action->Deep Breath.description: El giant coppermouth puede contener la respiracion durante 1 hora.

action->Greater Electrolocation.name: Greater Electrolocation
action->Greater Electrolocation.description: A giant coppermouth can sense minute electrical charges in living criaturas, which it can use as a precise sense at a range of 20 pies. Este distance increases to 100 pies against any criatura that has used an electricity effect within the last minute.

action->Coppermouth Venom.name: Coppermouth Venom
action->Coppermouth Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:25]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison],1d6[electricity]]{1d6 poison and 1d6 electricity} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[poison],1d6[electricity]]{2d6 poison and 1d6 electricity} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d6[poison],2d6[electricity]]{2d6 poison and 2d6 electricity} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2}

action->Quickening Jolt.name: Quickening Jolt
action->Quickening Jolt.description: The coppermouth manipulates its own nervous system by increasing its reaction time, Striding and making two Golpes against different targets during the movement. Both attacks count toward its multiple attack penalización, but the penalización doesn't increase until after it has made both attacks.

action->Venomous Spit.name: Venomous Spit
action->Venomous Spit.description: The coppermouth unleashes a stream of electrified venom in a @Template[line|distance:30]. The venom deals @Damage[8d6[electricity]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic|options:area-effect]) and criaturas that take daño from the venom are immediately exposed to coppermouth venom. The copper mouth can't use Venomous Spit again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Venomous Spit]]{1d4 rounds}.

Giant Fangtooth.name: Giant Fangtooth
Giant Fangtooth.publicNotes: A single bite from this criatura's signature fangs can cause death by blood loss within minutes; what's worse, the giant fangtooth is willing to attack criaturas far larger than itself.

action->Sunless Sight.name: Sunless Sight
action->Sunless Sight.description: In an area of bright light, the giant fangtooth is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Cegado} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1}.

action->Constrict.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.g26YiEIfSHCpLocV]

@Damage[(2d8)[piercing]], @Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

action->Deep Puncture.name: Deep Puncture
action->Deep Puncture.description: Las criaturas critically hit by the fangtooth's bite take an additional 1d8 daño persistente de sangrado.

Giant Tardigrade.name: Giant Tardigrade
Giant Tardigrade.publicNotes: Tardigrades grow no larger than el width de un hair, but cuando su riverside environments son exposed a heightened levels de magia, these eight-legged omnivores puede grow a tremendous sizes.

action->Eyespots.name: Eyespots
action->Eyespots.description: A giant tardigrade can't see anything beyond 30 pies.

action->Tun State.name: Tun State
action->Tun State.description:
Desencadenante The tardigrade would be reduced to 0 Puntos de Golpe or would die due to starvation, suffocation, or similar environmental causes

Frecuencia once per week

Requisitos The tardigrade isn't already in tun state

Efecto The giant tardigrade doesn't die but instead remains at 1 Hit Point and curls into a dry ball, called a tun. While in this tun state, the giant tardigrade is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconsciente}, doesn't need to eat, drink, or breathe, and doubles its resistance to 20. It remains in tun state indefinitely until covered in significant amounts of water, at which point it begins to rehydrate, gaining regeneration 5. The regeneration persists until it reaches maximum Puntos de Golpe. The giant tardigrade then exits its tun state.

action->Vacuum Mouth.name: Vacuum Mouth
action->Vacuum Mouth.description:
Requisitos The giant tardigrade doesn't have a target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado}

Efecto The giant tardigrade draws in air with its mouth. All criaturas in a @Template[cone|distance:20] must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:25] save or be pulled adjacent to the giant tardigrade. The tardigrade chooses one criatura that failed its save, Grabbing el objetivo in its claws and making a stylet Golpe.

Goblin Shark.name: Goblin Shark
Goblin Shark.publicNotes:
Numerous species de sharks make su homes en el ocean's depths, rarely encountered by land-dwellers.

Goblin sharks son deep-sea hunters, dwelling near el ocean suelo. They make up for su slow swimming speed con stealthy ambushes, allowing prey a get dentro de reach before lashing out con su extending jaws.

action->Blood Scent.name: Blood Scent
action->Blood Scent.description: El shark puede smell sangre en el agua de up a 1 mile away.

action->Camouflage.name: Camuflaje
action->Camouflage.description: The goblin shark's coloration blends in with the water. It doesn't need cover to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} with a STEALTH check while underwater.

action->Electrolocation.name: Electrolocation
action->Electrolocation.description: A goblin shark can sense minute electrical charges in living criaturas, which it can use as a precise sense at a range of 20 pies.

action->Grasping Jaws.name: Grasping Jaws
action->Grasping Jaws.description: Las criaturas that successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} from the goblin shark's jaws take @Damage[1d6[bleed]] as the shark's hold tears flesh away.

action->Lunging Bite.name: Lunging Bite
action->Lunging Bite.description: The goblin shark dashes forward and extends its jaws bite a criatura. It swims up to 10 pies in a straight line and makes a jaws Golpe with a reach of 10 pies.

action->Three-Headed.name: Three-Headed
action->Three-Headed.description: Any ability that would sever a greater chimera's head (such as a critical hit with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6xaxxKfvXED6LfIY]{Vorpal} arma) severs one head at random. Losing a head doesn't kill a chimera (as long as it has at least one head left), but it does prevent it from making Golpes with the lost head or using any abilities granted by the head.

action->Multiple Reactions.name: Multiple Reactions
action->Multiple Reactions.description: A greater chimera gains 2 extra reactions each round that it can use only to make Reactive Golpes. It must use a different head for each reaction, and it can't use more than one on the same triggering action. If it loses one of its heads, it also loses one of these extra reactions.

action->Three-Headed Strike.name: Three-Headed Golpe
action->Three-Headed Strike.description: The greater chimera makes a Golpe with each of its heads, each at a –2 penalización and targeting a different criatura. Estos Golpes count as only one attack for the greater chimera's multiple attack penalización, and the penalización doesn't increase until after it has made all three attacks.

Harbor Seal.name: Harbor Seal
Harbor Seal.publicNotes: Harbor seals son el most common seals found en Golarion y famous for su soft, furry bodies. They're vicious hunters underwater, but typically shy de humanoides en el surface, preferring a ocultarse among el waves rather than face down what seems a be un terrifying land predator.

action->Deep Breath.name: Contener La Respiración
action->Deep Breath.description: A harbor seal puede contener la respiracion durante 30 minutos.

action->Whisker Sense.name: Whisker Sense
action->Whisker Sense.description: Un harbor seal puede usar su whiskers a sentido vibrations as un preciso sentido at el listed alcance, but solo underwater.

action->Aquatic Ambush.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.HBrBrUzjfvj2gDXB]

40 pies.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AquaticAmbush]

action->Aquatic Feast.name: Aquatic Feast
action->Aquatic Feast.description:
Requisitos The harbor seal has a Medium or smaller criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} in its jaws

Efecto The harbor seal Swims up to 10 pies, carrying its grabbed criatura along with it dealing @Damage[1d8[slashing]] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] save).

Hardhead Mole.name: Hardhead Mole
Hardhead Mole.publicNotes:
Mischievous, burrowing hardhead moles reside mainly in the grasslands and plains. One can often spot their burrowing by following the upended ground they leave behind, which can span for hundreds of pies. Their signature physiological feature is a shiny, gem-like cranium that's thick enough to endure repeated hits and emits a flash of colorful light with each impact.

Agrarian gnome communities have a close relationship with hardhead moles. Gnome children especially hold a great fondness for the criaturas, and indeed, gave them their name. When they wander into the fields to play with these moles—typically by hitting them with small sticks, mallets, or any semi-blunt object—the moles are more than happy to oblige, darting from burrow to burrow with every sparkling blow in friendly games of hide-and-seek or tag.

Perhaps the most famous hardhead mole is the gnome goddess Nivi Rhombodazzle's planar servitor Rummbrrlar, a hardhead mole imbued by Nivi with the powers of an earth elemental. Long ago, the mighty mole was slain while rescuing children from a Nivian orphanage. As a reward for his selfless actions, Rummbrrlar was transformed into a planar servitor with diamond skin and the ability to grow as large as a mighty dragon. When communities shared by gnomes and hardhead moles are threatened, Rummbrrlar often appears to whisk bystanders to safety in the face of natural hazards or stand guard against monstrous threats. For this reason, hardhead moles are seen as a good omen and a symbol of protection in gnome communities.

The average hardhead mole grows up to about 3 pies in length, but some become shorter as they age, their hard skulls flattening slightly after years of entertaining young gnomes. As they play, their heads (and the flashes of light they emit) darken in color, spanning shades of pink, red, crimson, and mauve; at seeing these darker hues, gnomes often give the moles some time to recover, as this indicates that a mole's cranium isn't getting enough blood flow. Though mischievous, hardhead moles are otherwise docile and friendly criaturas. If placed in a fight-or-flight situation, they escape by creating deep networks of tunnels, which can span up to hundreds of pies in any direction.

Holdfast.name: Holdfast
Holdfast.publicNotes:
A sleek body, large talons, and keen senses make the holdfast an experto hunter, far deadlier than its small size might indicate. It typically approaches prey from below, then pounces in a flurry of teeth and talons, trying to crush el objetivo's windpipe with its powerful jaws. Este ambush strategy is further aided by its dappled gray fur, camouflaging it against the rocky terrain of its native habitat. Today, holdfasts have spread far, often because of orc holds adopting them as hunting companions. Este has led to tension with other peoples, who often find holdfasts too difficult to work with and consider them an invasive species—even gnomes and druids who can speak with holdfasts find them distractable and murderously energetic.

Although holdfasts watch over their litters very carefully, adults avoid each other outside of their short mating season. Despite this antipathy for others of their kind, holdfasts often trail other species of predators, acting as opportunistic scavengers. Este typically ends with the holdfast bullying the other criatura and stealing the greater share of any kill, but it can develop into a mutualistic arrangement. Many holdfasts have been observed hunting alongside eagles and other birds of prey, driving underground criaturas to the surface for the birds to pick off.

Holdfasts are difficult to contain, sliding through tiny openings and digging under fences, meaning proper enclosures must be made of stone or metal on all sides. Some orc communities instead lay out humane traps when their hunting parties are needed, using favorite treats as bait. In the orc-run nation of Belkzen, overlord Ardax the White-Hair's chief animal handler claims to have a unique and confidential training process that curbs the holdfasts' impulse to escape, but other handlers have yet to uncover or replicate it. In the Gravelands, the major orc communities face the unwelcome intrusion of undead headed by the Whispering Tyrant. While they maintain the original bond with holdfasts as hunting partners, the goal has changed from providing subsistence to eradicating undead.

Hooplamander.name: Hooplamander
Hooplamander.publicNotes:
Many a traveler has heard a loud rumble from behind and turned to see a strange wheel bearing down upon them. Even if they can dodge it, they still might not be safe, for once the wheel stops, it unfurls into a hooplamander. Though whispered of in the remote expanses of Arcadia and feared along the grassy plains of the Mwangi Expanse, many in urban areas believe the seemingly ridiculous hooplamanders to be nothing more than tall tales. As the flattened remains of many caravans can attest, however, these apex predators are very real.

Hooplamanders resemble large salamanders. They're born with retractable rear legs and an incredibly strong, flexible spine. Their sharp foreclaws feature sharp hooks that can rend flesh or stabilize it when it enters its wheel-shaped form. As they develop, hooplamanders learn how to leap and roll, hooking their tails beneath their mouths and stabilizing them with their foreclaws to form a crude wheel that they use their tail muscles to propel forward. Their backs are ridged with a tread-like pattern that gives significant traction and maneuvering power. Hooplamanders are particularly deadly when they use their hooked claws to inflict bleeding wounds before entering their "wheels up" form to dash around the battlefield, trampling foes and waiting for their prey to bleed out.

Hooplamanders can be found wherever the ground is flat and open. Their coloring matches where they hunt, with those in grassy plains sporting brown-green skin and those in snowy regions bearing a white hide. Some naturalists believe the criaturas started out as salamanders that hatched within the acidic trail of the fabled ouroboros. Others believe that NATURE, in its infinite variety, doesn't need magic to create such criaturas—only an environment flat enough to reward their cunning adaptation.

Magnegor.name: Magnegor

Magnegors roam the mountains of Golarion, grazing on wild berries, edible roots, and other plants that favor iron-rich soil and high elevations. Estos hulking, woolly bovines have four curved horns—two extending from behind their ears, and two from below their jaws—that frame their skulls in an X shape. Their bodies are covered in thick, stringy hair with a texture akin to copper wire, parted only by massive neural spines of dense, nearly indestructible keratin.

Magnegors display a unique ability to manipulate magnetic fields through their coats and spines and have a strange predilection for crushing metals and precious ores by wallowing over them back and forth. As a result, unwary adventurers who accidentally wander into the middle of a magnegor herd rarely, if ever, make it out alive.

The value of the sickened condition increases each time the magnegor fails such a check, to a maximum of 3.

action->Excavating Spines.name: Excavating Spines
action->Excavating Spines.description: The magnegor inadvertently digs a 10-pies-deep continuous trench in any square it Wallows through, as long as the ground in that space isn't made of stone, rock, or some other surface too hard to excavate. The trench is greater difficult terrain. At the GM's discretion, any excavated square can reveal a deposit of sedimentary rock filled with metal ore that has Hardness 7 and 28 Puntos de Golpe.

action->Magnetized Coat.description: When a magnegor comes within 30 pies of a metal object or a deposit of metal ore, its thousands of wiry hairs stand on end, pointing towards the metal and creating a magnetic field. Metal items of light or negligible Bulk that touch the magnegor's coat adhere to it magnetically, requiring an INTERACT action to be pried free. Las criaturas wearing or primarily composed of metal treat all squares in a 10-pies radius around the magnegor as difficult terrain, unless they are moving directly towards it.

Este deals @Damage[4d10[piercing]] daño with a @Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save; on a failed save, a criatura wearing metal armor or made of metal is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} by the magnegor's magnetized coat (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC 24). Their paralytic venom and rapid digestive process conjuro a quick end for unsuspecting criaturas caught in their grasp.

Travelers who survive a mammoth land star's assault must take care to destroy the remains, as its regenerative ability will eventually revive it to continue its mission: feed. It is not uncommon for mammoth land star attacks to happen in succession one week after another, with greater numbers each time. Este is often caused by leaving limbs to regrow and resume their initial attack.

Marp.name: Marp
Marp.publicNotes:
While many criaturas hunger after gold, the blue-furred marp literally eats this precious metal as a vital part of their diet. Although a few marp families live near natural gold deposits, most sources of gold are already under some other criatura's control. Therefore, marps generally survive by ingratiating themselves to those criaturas. Once they have inured themselves with such a group, they will gather all the gold they can get.

Even hungry marps ask first, a display that varies by region but is rarely more complex than gripping their hands in the air and asking "gold?" in a plaintive voice. Marp cultures consider this process of asking first to be virtuous, but they fundamentally think of gold as a food, not a trade good. As such, they will steal gold if refused, considering it justified the same way one might steal bread if starving. That being said, marps generally attempt to earn their keep by assisting in roles like prospectors or counterfeit detectors, for which their acute sense for gold makes them well suited.

Marps rarely engage in direct combat, preferring to run away if attacked. On the rare occasions they meet other criaturas that also eat minerals, they're generally willing to reach an equitable trade agreement.

The scent and feel of lead disgust marps. If a marp is given lead, they no longer approach that criatura and leave them alone. Even a single lead coin in a bag of gold is enough to protect the bag from theft, making such coins an effective deterrent in regions frequented by marps.

action->Goldsense.name: Goldsense
action->Goldsense.description: Marps puede sentido cualquier accumulation de oro dentro de alcance. They also puede precisely measure el purity de oro by touch.

action->Panicked Withdrawal.name: Panicked Withdrawal
action->Panicked Withdrawal.description:
Desencadenante The marp takes daño from a melee Golpe

Efecto The marp drops any items held in their hands, then Climbs or Strides up to 15 pies.

action->Gold?.name: Gold?
action->Gold?.description:
The marp asks for gold from all criaturas in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. Each target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save or retrieve and drop gold valuables as a free action.

Éxito crítico El objetivo can refuse the request, though they can also elige to willingly hand over any amount of gold. If they do so, they gain a +1 bonificador de estado to the next tirada de salvación they attempt within 1 minute, and they're temporarily immune to Scampering Theft for 1 minute.

Éxito El objetivo can refuse the request.

Fallo El objetivo must drop coins, gold jewelry, or other objects worth 20 gp.

Fallo crítico As failure, but 40 gp.

action->Scampering Theft.name: Scampering Theft
action->Scampering Theft.description:
The marp runs and attempts to snatch a purse, pendant, or other such object. The marp Strides up to their Velocidad, and they can move through enemigo spaces during this movement. They then attempt to steal valuables from el objetivo, who must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:22] save.

Éxito The marp fails to steal anything from el objetivo.

Fallo The marp steals one object from el objetivo's possession that is made of or contains gold. They can't steal objects held by or permanently attached to the criatura. If the object contains lead, the marp drops it at el objetivo's pies. After stealing the object (or dropping it), the marp then Strides up to their Velocidad.

action->Visage Strike.name: Visage Golpe
action->Visage Strike.description:
Desencadenante A criatura adjacent to the mirror wolf's visages damages mirror wolf's ally

Efecto The mirror wolf teleports to the visage's spot, destroying the visage, and makes a jaws Golpe.

action->Bond with Mortal.name: Vínculo con mortal
action->Bond with Mortal.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto The spirit guide spends 10 minutes to form a bond with a mortal criatura. While the bond exists, the spirit guide increases their current and maximum Puntos de Golpe by 14, gains a +2 bonificador de estado to their attack and tiradas de daño, and can communicate telepathically with the bonded mortal as long as the two beings are on the same plane. The spirit guide can only be bonded with one mortal at a time, and they can take this action again to end the bond or to form a new bond (which also ends the old bond). The bond also ends if the spirit guide or the mortal dies.

Este bond strengthens the spirit guide's connection to the Universe. While bonded, the spirit guide loses the incorporeal and spirit rasgos, loses their immunity to disease, paralysis, and poison, along with their resistance to all daño, and changes their Golpes to deal the appropriate amount of daño físico (typically piercing or slashing) instead of daño de fuerza.

action->Bonded Strike.name: Bonded Golpe
action->Bonded Strike.description:
Requisitos The mirror wolf is currently Bonded with a Mortal

Efecto The mirror wolf makes a jaws Golpe. If this attack hits, the bonded mortal can spend their reaction to Golpe the same target.

action->Lingering Assailant.name: Lingering Assailant
action->Lingering Assailant.description: The mirror wolf attacks with such speed it leaves a visage of itself behind. When the mirror wolf Golpes, they leave behind a visage in an adjacent square. The visage is treated as an ally for effects such as flanking and pack attack. A visage has AC 10 and 1 HP and lasts for 1 round.

action->Pack Attack.name: Ataque en manada
action->Pack Attack.description: The mirror wolf's Golpes deal 1d8 daño adicional to criaturas within reach of at least two of the mirror wolf's allies.

action->Strafing Strike.name: Strafing Golpe
action->Strafing Strike.description: The mirror wolf makes a jaws Golpe against a criatura within range. The mirror wolf can then Zancada and make a second jaws Golpe against the same criatura.

Mist Bear.name: Mist Bear
Mist Bear.publicNotes:
Like the mundane bears they resemble, a mist bear is motivated by simple pursuits, such as food. Unlike other ursines, the mist bear can dissipate into a cloud of ethereal vapor, greatly complicating the efforts of neighboring humanoids to keep their provisions safe from the criatura's depredations.

Fortunately, the mist bear follows a predictable pattern of behavior, usually foraging within the Universe for only a few months every year to gorge itself. Once sated, it then enters a state similar to hibernation where it drifts through the Ethereal Plane as a cloud of intangible vapor.

action->Mist Form.name: Mist Form
action->Mist Form.description: Over the course of a minute, a mist bear can transmute its form into a cloud of ethereal vapor. In this state it has resistance 10 to daño físico, is immune to daño de precisión, and can't use any actions with the attack or manipulate rasgo. It has a fly Velocidad of 10 pies and can slip through tiny cracks. The mist bear can return to solid form as a single action.

action->Clouded Charge.name: Clouded Charge
action->Clouded Charge.description: The mist bear Strides twice. During this movement, wisps of ethereal smoke trail from its body, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto}. The mist bear then Golpes. El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to this attack if the bear moved at least 20 pies.

action->Misty Mauling.name: Misty Mauling
action->Misty Mauling.description:
Requisitos The mist bear has a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado}

Efecto The mist bear digs its claws into the grabbed criatura as it dissipates into mist. The grabbed criatura takes @Damage[3d8[slashing]] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] save). The mist bear gains the benefits of its Mist Form, Flies up to 10 pies, and then returns to its solid form.

Mjolgat.name: Mjolgat
Mjolgat.publicNotes:
Over the millennium that they mined the rich mineral deposits of the Shattered Range, the dwarves of Dongun Hold discovered the stalwart mjolgat, a beast that exhibits the uncanny ability to sniff out ore deposits with its incredible sense of smell. To this day, dwarves across Golarion rear mjolgats as companions and draft animals, training them to locate precious metals @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} deep beneath the surface. Some dauntless dwarves even turn mjolgats into mounts, though those brave enough to do so often require ample ear protection, as the criaturas release horrifying shrieks when threatened.

Exhibiting a temperament that rivals even a dwarf's surliness, mjolgats have large, cranial crests of bone as broad and heavy as the head of a giant's warhammer. While the rest of their face resembles a cross between an elephant and a yak—with elongated snouts, rodentlike muzzles, and a two sets of horns—their bodies resemble those of squat boars. A straggly mane of thick brown fur covers their massive necks, which develop and strengthen over their life spans to support the massive columns of bone atop their heads. Adolescent mjolgats often lack such athleticism, walking backward and dragging their heads behind them until they can hold their necks upright. A dwarf down on their luck is often compared to a young mjolgat unable to lift their head off the ground.

action->Orescent.name: Orescent
action->Orescent.description: Un mjolgat puede detect el ores de unrefined precious metals con su powerful nose. Common earth y piedra do no impede el mjolgat de smelling ores deep dentro de el suelo.

action->Head On.name: Head On
action->Head On.description:
Desencadenante A criatura the mjolgat can see targets the mjolgat with an attack

Efecto The mjolgat swings its crest in the direction of the danger, gaining a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC against the triggering attack.

action->Hammerhead.name: Hammerhead
action->Hammerhead.description: The mjolgat rears upon its hind leg to crush an enemigo with its jagged crest of bone. The mjolgat makes a bone crest Golpe; on a hit, the mjolgat deals an extra die of daño. Este counts as two attacks when calculating the mjolgat's multiple attack penalización

action->Punch-Drunk.name: Punch-Drunk
action->Punch-Drunk.description: If the mjolgat critically fails a bone crest Golpe, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} for 1 round.

action->Rockbreaker.name: Rockbreaker
action->Rockbreaker.description: When the mjolgat deals daño to an object (such as a shield or an ore deposit), it deals double daño.

action->Shrieking Slam.name: Shrieking Slam
action->Shrieking Slam.description:
The mjolgat lets out a terrifying screech before bashing its head into the ground. Las criaturas within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 pies} of the mjolgat must attempt a @Check[will|dc:21] save. Regardless of the result of the save, they are then immune to Shrieking Slam.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

Fallo El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Huyendo} for 1 round.

Mocking Chorus.name: Mocking Chorus
Mocking Chorus.publicNotes:
Among the many unique criaturas of the Inner Sea, the hydras known as mocking choruses that stalk the River Kingdoms may be one of the most reviled. While as ferocious in direct combat as others of their kind, chorusus are a singular type of challenge for warriors that hunt them due not to their sharp teeth, but instead a sharp and subtle tongue. Their strangely cunning tactics and power to turn longtime friends into bitter enemies brings doubt to even the closest of allies.

Mocking choruses exhibit behavior that seem to indicate a more elevated INTELLIGENCE than other hydras. They do not appear to eat in large quantities, leaving little sign they have passed by and spurring rumors that they prey on settlements more for sport than sustenance. Every few years sees a new story of a whole village turning on itself. Neighbor against neighbor, the village tears itself apart; some go missing, and only the sounds of hissing laughter precede the event.

action->Uncanny Mimicry.name: Uncanny Mimicry
action->Uncanny Mimicry.description: While unable to communicate for prolonged periods, a mocking chorus can precisely imitate a humanoid voice. If a criatura speaks within audible range of the mocking chorus, the mocking chorus can speak using the criatura's voice, even if it says different words than what were spoken. Las criaturas that hear the mocking chorus speak this way can attempt a @Check[will|dc:40] save to recognize the source. On a success, criaturas gain a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to all tiradas de salvación against the mocking chorus' abilities for 1 minute.

action->Hydra Regeneration.name: Hydra Regeneración
action->Hydra Regeneration.description: The hydra has regeneration equal to 3 × the number of heads it has. If a hydra's body is missing any heads and the remaining stumps have not been cauterized, the hydra attempts a @Check[fortitude|immutable:true|dc:43] save after it regains Puntos de Golpe from regeneration. On a success, one uncauterized stump regrows two heads; on a critical success, two uncauterized stumps regrow into two heads each. The hydra can never grow more than double the number of heads it ordinarily has. The hydra's regeneration only fully deactivates if all its heads are severed and all stumps are cauterized, at which point it dies.

action->Head Regrowth.name: Head Regrowth
action->Head Regrowth.description:
A mocking chorus ordinarily has ten heads. A criatura can attempt to sever one of the hydra's heads by specifically targeting it and dealing daño equal to the head's Puntos de Golpe. A head that is not completely severed returns to full Puntos de Golpe at the end of any criatura's turn. A hydra can regrow a severed head using hydra regeneration. A criatura can prevent this regrowth by dealing acid or daño de fuego to the stump, cauterizing it. Single-target acid or fire effects need to be targeted at a specific stump, but effects that deal daño de salpicadura or affect areas covering the hydra's whole space cauterize all stumps if they deal acid or daño de fuego. If the attack that severs a head deals any acid or daño de fuego, the stump is cauterized instantly. If all ten heads are cauterized, the hydra dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.uZJOdounIHaFDC1t]{Efecto: Hydra Heads}

action->Reactive Heads.name: Reactive Heads
action->Reactive Heads.description: A hydra gains an extra reaction per round for each of its heads beyond the first, which it can use only to make Reactive Golpes. It can't use more than 1 reaction on the same triggering action, even if a criatura leaves several squares within its reach, and the hydra must use a different head for each Reactive Golpe it makes. Siempre que one of the hydra's heads is severed, the hydra loses 1 of its extra reactions per round.

action->Petty Whispers.name: Petty Whispers
action->Petty Whispers.description:
The mocking chorus adopts the voices of its enemies, spreading lies and jeers among would-be allies and tearing apart trusted friends. Las criaturas in a @Template[emanation|distance:60] of the mocking chorus must attempt a @Check[will|dc:37] save. The mocking chorus can't use petty whispers again for 1 minute.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 1 day.

Éxito As failure, but the criatura takes half daño and is not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confundido}.

Fallo The criatura takes @Damage[12d10[mental]] daño and is confused for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Fallo crítico The criatura takes @Damage[15d10[mental]] daño and is confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Morthak.name: Morthak
Morthak.publicNotes:
Dischorans son un group de predators who hunt via focused sound. Though ellos possess protuberances que resemble eyes, these son actually auditory sensory organs que puede pick up even el slightest sound y son used a locate prey con pinpoint accuracy.

Only un few types de dischorans tienen been identified, but ellos todos share unifying features: front-facing pseudo-eyes, deceptive speed, y ravenous hunger. Their sensitivity a noise combined con su ability a weaponize sound son likely el primary reasons dischorans spend most de su time alone.

Morthaks, being low, squat, y flat, resemble un crocodile rebuilt a dig like un mole. At home beneath vast meadows y plains, el solo sign de su passing son el earthen mounds ellos leave behind cuando ellos emerge a hunt. Those who encounter them en el wild speak de el sub-aural rumble ellos produce as ellos disintegrate el earth con sonico blasts, un sound que's felt rather than heard.

action->Sensitive Echolocation.name: Sensitive Echolocation
action->Sensitive Echolocation.description: The morthak can use its hearing as a precise sense with the listed range. If the morthak takes daño sónico beyond its resistance, its senses are overloaded and all criaturas are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} from it for 1 round.

action->Auditory Swipe.name: Auditory Swipe
action->Auditory Swipe.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within the morthak's reach uses an auditory action

Efecto The morthak makes a claw Golpe against the triggering criatura.

action->Shattering Scrape.name: Shattering Scrape
action->Shattering Scrape.description: The morthak makes a claw Golpe against a criatura wearing stone or metal armor. If the Golpe hits and the armor's Hardness is 12 or lower, that armor is broken.

Pale Horse.name: Caballo pálido
Pale Horse.publicNotes: El death de un unicorn en un particularly cruel manner leads a el creation de un pale horse—un symbol de hope y purity transformed into one de hopelessness y despair.

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]
Darkness (At-Will)

action->Spectral Mount.name: Spectral Mount
action->Spectral Mount.description: A pale horse can accept a corporeal rider, but such a rider is left behind if the pale horse passes through a criatura or object.

action->Aura of Despair.name: Aura de desesperacion
action->Aura of Despair.description: 30 pies. A living criatura that begins its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:27] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1}. A criatura is temporarily immune to the aura for 1 hour if it critically succeeds.

action->Spectral Charge.name: Spectral Charge
action->Spectral Charge.description: The pale horse Flies twice and then makes a horn Golpe. The pale horse can move through criaturas.

Plated Python.name: Plated Python
Plated Python.publicNotes:
Gorgons are a broad group of animals that share a few peculiar rasgos. All gorgons are covered in armored plates and breathe petrifying gases. Other than these features, gorgons can resemble almost any animal. While some gorgons may seem like less physically imposing criaturas, they should never be underestimated. Gorgons are canny hunters, and even a small puff of their breath can immobilize almost any prey.

One of the most fearsome gorgons is the gigantic plated python, covered from nose to tail in large metallic scales. Rather than the venom used by many other snakes, its breath turns both criaturas and objects into stone. While this poses the most danger to the prey caught in its jaws, it can also transform large areas to brittle and lifeless stone that the snakes can easily tunnel through.

Plated pythons typically live in pairs or trios and are extremely territorial. The fights between plated pythons over territory are vicious and tend to leave long-lasting effects on the landscape. They defend their territory aggressively against other criaturas they see as a threat, including people and large animals. Their habitats can be identified by the stone tunnels left behind by their burrowing, and wary travelers use these as a sign to change course. Particularly bold adventurers might try to use the tunnels for passage, protected as they are from elements and other wildlife, but they do risk coming face to face with a plated python.

action->Constrict.description:

action->Crumbling Earth.description: The plated python lets its breath sink into the ground, transforming it to brittle stone within a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. The stone is difficult terrain to all other criaturas. Other criaturas on the ground in this area when it transforms must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:29] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} as the stone beneath them crumbles to rubble. A criatura immobilized in this way can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} normally or use three total INTERACT actions to dig themself free.

action->Petrify Prey.name: Petrify Prey
action->Petrify Prey.description:
Requisitos The plated python has a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado}

Desencadenante The plated python begins its turn

Efecto The python's breath seeps into the grabbed criatura. That criatura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura's body hardens and stiffens, causing it to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for 1 round.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrificado} for 1 round and Swallowed Whole.

Fallo crítico The criatura is petrified permanently and Swallowed Whole.

action->Stone Tunnel.name: Stone Tunnel
action->Stone Tunnel.description: When a plated python burrows through ground, it petrifies and destroys the material in front of it, leaving a 5-pies diameter tunnel in its wake. A plated python doesn't need to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze} to pass through any space at least that wide.

action->Swallow Whole.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]

Large, @Damage[(3d10+5)[acid]], Rupture 20

Este daño ignores the hardness of petrified criaturas.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

action->Towering Bite.name: Towering Bite
action->Towering Bite.description: The plated python lunges to its full length, making a jaws Golpe with a reach of 60 pies. If the Golpe hits, its target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} and pulled to an empty space adjacent to the plated python. The python can attack through any material it can burrow through, leaving a stone tunnel as normal.

Prismhydra.name: Prismhydra
Prismhydra.publicNotes:
El most commonly seen hydra famously tiene five cabezas que ello usa en unison a ataque prey o assailants. Scattered across el Inner Sea region son more fantastical breeds de el beast, cada con su own curious evolution y hunting behavior.

Prismhydras, yet another inexplicable byproduct de el Mana Wastes' tumultuous magico properties, wander el land between Nex y Geb feasting en megafauna, mutants, y whatever else happens a cross su path. Their scales cascade en various colors, shifting en beautiful patterns que belie el threat de su powerful jaws. Only el most prepared adventurers puede slay un prismhydra, for el means de stopping su regeneration es like un single card en un explosive deck.

action->Hydra Regeneration.name: Hydra Regeneración
action->Hydra Regeneration.description: The hydra has regeneration equal to 3 × the number of heads it has. If a hydra's body is missing any heads and the remaining stumps have not been cauterized, the hydra attempts a @Check[fortitude|immutable:true|dc:39] save after it regains Puntos de Golpe from regeneration. On a success, one uncauterized stump regrows two heads; on a critical success, two uncauterized stumps regrow into two heads each. The hydra can never grow more than double the number of heads it ordinarily has. The hydra's regeneration only fully deactivates if all its heads are severed and all stumps are cauterized, at which point it dies.

action->Prismatic Backlash.name: Prismatic Backlash
action->Prismatic Backlash.description:
Desencadenante A criatura successfully cauterizes one of the prismhydra's stumps

Efecto The unstable prismatic energies in the prismhydra's body surge forth. Each criatura adjacent to the prismhydra is exposed to its chromatic explosion.

action->Prismatic Head Regrowth.name: Prismatic Head Regrowth
action->Prismatic Head Regrowth.description:
A prismhydra ordinarily has eight heads. A criatura can attempt to sever one of the hydra's heads by specifically targeting it and dealing daño equal to the head's Puntos de Golpe. A head that is not completely severed returns to full Puntos de Golpe at the end of any criatura's turn. A hydra can regrow a severed head using hydra regeneration.

Each head requires a different type of daño to cauterize; typically, two heads each are vulnerable to acid, cold, electricity, and daño de fuego, but other combinations or more exotic vulnerabilities are possible. When a prismhydra successfully regrows heads, all the heads regrown have the same vulnerability, which must be the same as the vulnerability of one of the prismhydra's unsevered heads.

If all eight heads are cauterized, the hydra dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.uZJOdounIHaFDC1t]{Efecto: Hydra Heads}

action->Prismhydra Heads.name: Prismhydra Heads
action->Prismhydra Heads.description:
HP (head) 36, prismatic head regrowth

Immunities area daño

Weaknesses slashing 15

action->Reactive Heads.name: Reactive Heads
action->Reactive Heads.description: A hydra gains an extra reaction per round for each of its heads beyond the first, which it can use only to make Reactive Golpes. It can't use more than 1 reaction on the same triggering action, even if a criatura leaves several squares within its reach, and the hydra must use a different head for each Reactive Golpe it makes. Siempre que one of the hydra's heads is severed, the hydra loses 1 of its extra reactions per round.

action->Chromatic Explosion.name: Chromatic Explosion
action->Chromatic Explosion.description: A prismhydra's heads are replete with arcane energy. Siempre que the prismhydra successfully Golpes an opponent with its spittle, or when an opponent cauterizes one of the prismhydra's heads, the opponent takes 6d6 daño of the type matching the head's vulnerability (typically @Damage[6d6[acid]]{acid}, @Damage[6d6[cold]]{cold}, @Damage[6d6[fire]]{fire}, or @Damage[6d6[electricity]]{electricity}), with a @Check[reflex|dc:37|basic] save.

Protoceratops.name: Protoceratops
Protoceratops.publicNotes: Though ello lacks el distinctive horns de su larger relative el triceratops, el protoceratops es more than capable de holding su own en combat, using su cola a knock enemigos a el suelo y su sturdy frill a turn away blows.

action->Defensive Posture.name: Defensive Posture
action->Defensive Posture.description: The protoceratops tucks in its head and presents its sturdy frill, granting a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to AC adjacent allies. The protoceratops remains in its Defensive Posture until the start of its next turn, but only grants the bonus while allies remain adjacent

action->Frill Block.name: Frill Block
action->Frill Block.description:
Requisitos The protoceratops is in its Defensive Posture

Desencadenante An adjacent ally would take daño from a physical attack

Efecto The protoceratops partially blocks the blow with its frill, reducing the daño by 5.

Rift Chameleon.name: Rift Chameleon
Rift Chameleon.publicNotes: Rift chameleons are best known for their unsettling ability to swallow criaturas significantly larger than themselves, thanks to a digestive tract that connects to its own pocket of the Ethereal Plane. When two or more rift chameleons remain in proximity for extended periods of time, their partially extradimensional NATURE begins to subtly warp the surrounding terrain. Direction and distance become confused to all but the lizards, making it easy for locals to get lost in places they once thought familiar.

action->Extradimensional Gullet.name: Extradimensional Gullet
action->Extradimensional Gullet.description: The rift chameleon's innards exist partially on the Ethereal Plane, allowing it to swallow any number of criaturas, even ones larger than itself. Las criaturas that @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} or cut themselves free from the chameleon's stomach reappear in the Universe adjacent to the rift chameleon's position. Las criaturas cannot escape from the rift chameleon's gullet using teleportation effects unless those effects can also cross planar boundaries.

action->Flickering Dash.name: Flickering Dash
action->Flickering Dash.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto The rift chameleon Strides twice. During this movement, it flits quickly between the Universe and the Ethereal Plane, gaining resistance 5 to daño físico.

action->Ethereal Camouflage.name: Ethereal Camouflage
action->Ethereal Camouflage.description: A rift chameleon can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, even if it doesn't have cover, but it cannot be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} from criaturas on the Ethereal Plane.

action->Swallow Whole.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]

Large, @Damage[(1d12+2)[bludgeoning]], Rupture 10

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

action->Tongue Pull.name: Tongue Pull
action->Tongue Pull.description: Any criatura hit by the rift chameleon's tongue is pulled adjacent to the chameleon. The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to the next Golpe the rift chameleon makes against it this round.

Royal Basilisk.name: Royal Basilisk
Royal Basilisk.publicNotes: The royal basilisk is aptly named, not for only the metal crown upon its head but also for the unique potency of its poison. The criatura's poison manifests as a sort of cloying vapor that sticks onto and eats away at anything it touches. Their mastery of poison does appear to come at a cost, as the royal basilisk has no ability to petrify its prey. Although the royal basilisk can painstakingly shape a crown, some made of simple iron and others of rare skymetals, they much prefer to collect crowns crafted by other criaturas.

action->Crowned Royalty.name: Crowned Royalty
action->Crowned Royalty.description: The royal basilisk's crown is firmly attached to its head but can be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarmed} as though it were a held item. Without a crown, the royal basilisk's mastery over poison is weakened enough that it loses its miasmatic shroud. The royal basilisk can equip a crown within its tail's reach as an INTERACT action. A royal basilisk's crown is normally made of iron and enables the basilisk to use miasmatic shroud, but crowns made of other, more exotic materials might confer different abilities.

action->Miasmatic Shroud.name: Miasmatic Shroud
action->Miasmatic Shroud.description: 15 pies. The poison in the breath of the royal basilisk makes the air around it a haze, concealing it from all criaturas outside the aura, but it cannot use this concealment to Hide or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}. When a criatura ends its turn within the aura, it is exposed to royal basilisk venom.

action->Greater Constrict.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.OmV6E3aELvq9CkK1]

@Damage[(4d8+3)[bludgeoning]], @Check[fortitude|dc:32|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.GreaterConstrict]

action->Royal Basilisk Venom.name: Royal Basilisk Venom
action->Royal Basilisk Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación DC 36

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d10[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d10[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 3} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[4d10[poison]], torpe 3, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} (1 round)

action->Stone-Hewing Spit.name: Stone-Hewing Spit
action->Stone-Hewing Spit.description: The royal basilisk spits its poison with immense force, dealing @Damage[5d10[acid],5d8[piercing]|options:area-damage]{5d10 acid and 5d8 piercing} daño (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic|options:area-effect] save) to criaturas in a @Template[line|distance:240] and exposing each criatura that took daño to royal basilisk venom. The line penetrates barriers with Hardness of less than 20, ignoring any bonuses they'd provide from cover. The royal basilisk can't use Stone-Hewing Spit again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Stone-Hewing Spit]]{1d4 rounds}.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]
