@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

action->Wrap in Coils.name: Wrap in Coils
action->Wrap in Coils.description:
Requisitos A Large or smaller criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} in the royal basilisk's jaws

Efecto The royal basilisk moves the criatura into its coils, freeing its jaws to make attacks, then uses Greater Constrict against the criatura. The royal basilisk's coils can hold as many criaturas as will fit in its space.

Rumindrol.name: Rumindrol
Rumindrol.publicNotes: The elusive rumindrol, an apex predator of the Darklands, lives deep below the surface of Golarion. Capable of emitting siren-like calls that reverberate far and wide through the tunnel systems surrounding its lair, a rumindrol feasts on the giant subterranean worms drawn to its call—as well as shulns and other criaturas that feed in the worms' wake—by building up sickening subsonic vibrations within its targets until they are unable to move.

action->Motion Sense.name: Motion Sense
action->Motion Sense.description: Un rumindrol puede sentido nearby motion through vibration y air movement.

action->Dreadful Resonance.name: Dreadful Resonance
action->Dreadful Resonance.description: 60 pies. Each criatura that enters or starts its turn in the emanation must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:36] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 2} on a critical failure) and take @Damage[3d8[sonic]] daño.

action->Enthralling Call.name: Enthralling Call
action->Enthralling Call.description: 1 mile. Each non-rumindrol criatura that enters or starts its turn within the emanation must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:26] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinado}. The criatura then becomes temporarily immune to this effect for 1 day (1 hour on a critical failure). Any criatura fascinated in this way will attempt to find the source of the rumindrol's cry, mindlessly wandering towards it.

action->Entropic Cry.name: Entropic Cry
action->Entropic Cry.description:
The rumindrol focuses its sonic emanations on a criatura it's aware of within the area of its enthralling call aura. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:31] save.

Éxito crítico The criatura becomes temporarily immune to Entropic Cry for 1 hour.

Éxito El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1}.

Fallo El objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 2}.

Fallo crítico El objetivo is sickened 2, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Debilitado 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1}.

action->Fast Swallow.name: Tragar rápido
action->Fast Swallow.description:
Desencadenante The rumindrol Grabs a criatura

Efecto The rumindrol uses Swallow Whole.

action->Inexorable.name: Inexorable
action->Inexorable.description: The rumindrol recovers from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido} conditions at the end of its turn. It's also immune to penalties to its Velocidades and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} condition, and it ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

action->Swallow Whole.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]

Huge, @Damage[(3d10+9)[bludgeoning]], Rupture 30

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

action->Thrash.name: Apalizar
action->Thrash.description: The rumindrol attempts individual Golpes against each criatura in its reach. It can attempt up to one jaws Golpe and any number of leg Golpes. Each attack counts toward the rumindrol's multiple attack penalización, but the penalización doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

Scroungefeather.name: Scroungefeather
Scroungefeather.publicNotes:
The large scavenger birds known as scroungefeathers make their homes near the sites of large battles. Estos birds feast on blood and carrion and have quickly learned that battlefields provide both in abundance. In spite of this grisly diet, they're best known for another strange adaptation: they build their nests from pieces of armor, armas, and magic items scavenged on the battlefields. Este leaves young scroungefeathers remarkably well protected, allowing both parents to leave the nest to search for food.

Alarmingly, scroungefeathers have learned how to use the items they scavenge for their nests to fend off attackers, flinging arrowheads, thrashing about with knives, and even activating the occasional wand. A scroungefeather nest makes a tempting target for adventurers and thieves, as the treasures tucked within can be quite valuable, but the birds defend their nests fiercely, particularly when there are eggs or chicks inside.

While the feathers of scroungefeathers don't have any magical properties, they're popular among thieves. Insignia for thieves' guilds often include the image of a black feather with two crimson stripes, and such organizations often send new recruits to raid a scroungefeather nest as part of their training.

action->Junk Nest.name: Junk Nest
action->Junk Nest.description: The scroungefeather's nest of sharp metallic junk covers a 15-pies-by-15-pies area. The area is difficult terrain and hazardous terrain to any non-scroungefeather criaturas. A criatura that moves on the ground through the nest takes @Damage[3[piercing]] daño for each square of the area it moves into. Scroungefeathers can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} at any point in the nest.

action->Tossed Scraps.name: Tossed Scraps
action->Tossed Scraps.description:
Requisitos The scroungefeather has Grabbed Debris

Efecto The scroungefeather flings the debris at a target within 20 pies, making an tirada de ataque with a +12 modifier. On a success, el objetivo takes @Damage[(2d10+5)[bludgeoning]] daño.

action->Grab Debris.name: Grab Debris
action->Grab Debris.description:
Requisitos The scroungefeather is in its nest or another environment rich with debris

Efecto The scroungefeather uses an INTERACT action to GRAB an item with its beak, selected randomly; roll 1d4 to determine the type of debris. The scroungefeather gains access to the listed abilities until it uses Tossed Scraps to discard the debris or until it Releases the debris. The scroungefeather can't use its beak attack while it is using its beak to GRAB Debris.

d4 Item Efecto
1 Armor scrap The scroungefeather gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to its AC.
2 Shattered blade The scroungefeather gains a broken blade melee Golpe with a +12 attack modifier that deals 2d10+6 daño cortante.
3 Unexploded bomb When the scroungefeather throws this with Tossed Scraps, all the daño is daño de fuego, and the bomb also deals 3 daño de salpicadura de fuego.
4 Faulty wand The scroungefeather gains a magic bolt ranged Golpe witha +14 attack modifier that deals 2d6+6 daño de fuerza.

Shotalashu.name: Shotalashu
Shotalashu.languages: (no puede hablar any languages), empathic communication
Shotalashu.publicNotes:
Estos reptilian beasts of burden are primarily known for their telepathic NATURE and close bond with their riders. Shotalashus are native to the planet Castrovel, where they are the traditional mounts of lashunta warriors, though some have appeared on Golarion thanks to travel between the two worlds. Both elves and lashuntas have brought shotalashus to Golarion, though elves are somewhat more likely to sell or give them away.

Mounted combatants covet these alien criaturas, though taming one is not as simple as buying a horse or camel. A shotalashu must form a telepathic bond with their rider before any riding is permitted, and once the criatura forms such a bond, they will not permit any other rider. While telepaths have the easiest time forming this bond, others have found ways to prove their worth.

Any shotalashus encountered in the wilds of Golarion most likely escaped from captivity—a notable wild pack exists on the Isle of Kortos, descended from such runaways. Would-be riders are most likely to find available shotalashus in Absalom, Kyonin, and southern Garund. Shotalashus are extravagantly expensive to raise on Golarion, resulting in corresponding prices when they appear on the market. However, the friends of riders who've passed will often help the surviving shotalashus find a new rider once they're ready.

action->Empathic Communication.name: Empathic Communication
action->Empathic Communication.description: While a shotalashu no puede hablar, even telepathically, it understands simple commands in the languages it knows. It returns telepathic sensations of emotion to criaturas touching it or the partner of its telepathic link at any distance.

action->Telepathic Link.name: Telepathic Link
action->Telepathic Link.description: A rider who would tame a shotalashu for a mount must first form a telepathic link with it. Establishing this link require spending a week with the desired mount and succeeding at a @Check[occultism|dc:21] check. Any criatura with telepathic capabilities, such as telepathy, touch telepathy, empathic sense, or the ability to cast conjuros such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HqTI6wRrck1YXp3F]{Telepathy}, gains a +4 bonificador de circunstancia to this check. Este link remains and neither can form a new link until one member dies. The shock of a partner dying leaves the survivor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2} for 24 hours and prevents forming a new link for at least a month.

action->Jungle Stride.name: Jungle Zancada
action->Jungle Stride.description: El shotalashu ignora el terreno dificil due a vegetation.

action->Telepathic Pounce.name: Telepathic Pounce
action->Telepathic Pounce.description:
The shotalashu hunts by pinning its foes with its mind. One criatura within 30 pies must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] save.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura takes a –5 pies penalización de estado to its Velocidades for one round.

Fallo The criatura takes a –10 pies penalización de estado to its Velocidades for one round. The shotalashu can then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Inmovilizado} for one round. The shotalashu can Leap.

Sky Fisher.name: Sky Fisher
Sky Fisher.publicNotes:
The sky fisher is an unusual aerial predator, mostly found in tropical jungle regions but occasionally seen as far north as Varisia. Naturalists believe it's a distant relative of the jellyfish that has evolved into a new ecological niche through prolonged exposure to elemental energies from the Plane of Air. That the biggest, most aggressive sky fishers are found (and thought to have originated) near powerful loci of elemental air, such as in Garund's Terwa Uplands or around the Eye of Abendego, lends further credence to this theory.

In appearance, a sky fisher resembles an enormous jellyfish, its many dangling tendrils hanging beneath a clear bulbous body. Although its appearance is quite difficult to accurately determine, as its natural transparent form is almost completely @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, its inside contain a complex chemical factory that produces lighter-than-air gases, paralyzing toxins, and flesh-eating enzymes. Estos enzymes are highly potent and often desired by toxicologists due to their unique properties. The criatura hunts by hovering just above the forest canopy, using eye-like clusters on the ends of its tentacles as a kind of inverted periscope. When it spots prey, it floats close and waits for an opportune moment to sting. Then, as paralysis takes hold, the sky fisher hoists its meal into the sky to slowly consume it. Inside, enzymes break down the dead or paralyzed victims into a bloody slurry.

A recently fed sky fisher can always be quickly identified by the looping coils of blood that circulate through its body—a beautiful, if terrible, sight.

action->Transparency.name: Transparency
action->Transparency.description: Unless it has fed recently, the sky fisher is naturally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. Using non-hostile actions does not cause the sky fisher to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}. When it takes a hostile action of any kind, the sky fisher is hidden instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{No detectado} until the start of its next turn, as the vague outline of its many tendrils temporarily becomes faintly visible.

action->Abduct.name: Abduct
action->Abduct.description: The sky fisher reels in a target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} by its tentacles, pulling them into an adjacent space, and then attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]{Swallow them Whole} (Large, @Damage[(3d8+12)[acid]], Rupture 25). The sky fisher can only use Swallow Whole when using Abduct.

action->Enzymic Vent.name: Enzymic Vent
action->Enzymic Vent.description: The sky fisher vents flesh-eating enzymes into the air, dealing @Damage[3d6[persistent,acid],3d6[bleed]|options:area-damage]{3d6 daño persistente de ácido and 3d6 daño persistente de sangrado} in a @Template[emanation|distance:20] (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect] save). It can't use Enzymic Vent again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Enzymic Vent]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Jet.name: Chorro
action->Jet.description: The sky fisher quickly expels some of its gases to move swiftly through the air, Flying up to 100 pies in a straight line; this movement no desencadena reacciones.

action->Sky Fisher Venom.name: Sky Fisher Venom
action->Sky Fisher Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:25]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] daño, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1}, and no puede hablar above a whisper (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[3d8[poison]] daño, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2}, and no puede hablar (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[3d10[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralizado} (1 round)

Soniphak.name: Soniphak
Soniphak.publicNotes:
Dischorans son un group de predators who hunt via focused sound. Though ellos possess protuberances que resemble eyes, these son actually auditory sensory organs que puede pick up even el slightest sound y son used a locate prey con pinpoint accuracy.

Only un few types de dischorans tienen been identified, but ellos todos share unifying features: front-facing pseudo-eyes, deceptive speed, y ravenous hunger. Their sensitivity a noise combined con su ability a weaponize sound son likely el primary reasons dischorans spend most de su time alone.

Often mistaken for drakes, soniphaks glide above rocky o barren suelo, picking out prey con su oido. Un hunting soniphak disables su objetivos con concentrated bursts de sound before snatching them up y feasting en el mover. Despite being able a speak, soniphaks son no more social than otro dischorans, generally responding a even el quietest attempts at communication con destructive shouting.

action->Sensitive Echolocation.name: Sensitive Echolocation
action->Sensitive Echolocation.description: The soniphak can use its hearing as a precise sense with the listed range. If the soniphak takes daño sónico beyond its resistance, its senses are overloaded and all criaturas are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} from it for 1 round.

action->Snatch.name: Snatch
action->Snatch.description: The soniphak can Fly at half Velocidad with a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} in its claws, carrying that criatura along with it.

action->Aftershock.name: Aftershock
action->Aftershock.description: Siempre que a soniphak hits with a screech Golpe, feedback deals each criatura the soniphak has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Agarrado} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Neutralizado} @Damage[1d6[sonic]] daño.

action->Disruptive Screech.name: Disruptive Screech
action->Disruptive Screech.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 30 pies of the soniphak uses an auditory action

Efecto The soniphak makes a screech Golpe against the triggering criatura. Este disrupts a triggering concentrate action if the Golpe is a critical hit.

action->Shattering Scream.name: Shattering Scream
action->Shattering Scream.description: The soniphak can focus its screech at a stone or rock surface within 60 pies to create an explosion in a @Template[burst|distance:15] from the point of impact. Las criaturas in the area take @Damage[5d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic|options:area-effect] save), and the area becomes difficult terrain due to fragments of loose stone.

Sporeback Frog.name: Sporeback Frog
Sporeback Frog.publicNotes: Este burrowing frog digs itself into moist earth so poisonous moss and toxic mushrooms can grow on its body.

0.label: para Salto de altura o Salto de longitud

action->Seed Spores.name: Seed Spores
action->Seed Spores.description: A criatura hit by the sporeback frog's tongue Golpe takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] daño as fungal spores begin to grow.

action->Soporific Spores.name: Soporific Spores
action->Soporific Spores.description: The sporeback frog shakes the plants and fungi on its back until they emit a cloud of spores in a @Template[emanation|distance:20]. All criaturas in the area must succeed a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 2} for 1 minute (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 3} on a critical failure). Este ability can't be used again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Soporific Spores]]{1d4 rounds}.

Stargut Hydra.name: Stargut Hydra
Stargut Hydra.publicNotes:
The most commonly seen hydra famously has five heads that it uses in unison to attack prey or assailants. Scattered across the Inner Sea region are more fantastical breeds of the beast, each with their own curious evolution and hunting behavior.

While naturally carnivorous, the adaptable NATURE of hydras has led to an interesting divergence in the species and its preferred diet. The hydra population of Numeria, where organic prey is scarce, has developed the ability to digest stones and metal alloys. Those that strike upon a vein of skymetal for a meal can be forever changed by its properties, leading to a wide range of potential variations. As skymetal is a cornerstone of Numerian SOCIETY, stargut hydras are treated in much the same way farmers view a swarm of corn weevils. The Black Sovereign Kevoth Kul offers a substantial standing bounty for the deaths of these criaturas, in addition to purchasing whatever ore can be retrieved from their stomachs before it is digested.

action->Skymetal Metamorphosis.name: Skymetal Metamorphosis
action->Skymetal Metamorphosis.description:

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.Bds5RP9grJxhZALW]{Adamantine} The stargut hydra's Golpes bypass Hardness and are treated as adamantine. The stargut hydra gains resistance 10 to daño físico (except adamantine).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.lFRU108HnGlnMwqS]{Abysium} (aura, poison) The stargut hydra emits an aura of nauseating radiation from the abysium in its body. Any criatura that begins its turn within 30 pies of the stargut hydra is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.N4l6y6v9pKy8Nj5i]{Djezet} (magical) The stargut hydra gains a +2 bonificador de estado to saves against magic.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.5bRdhgghjtWF1Vuu]{Inubrix} The stargut hydra's Golpes ignore resistance to daño from metal armor's armor specialization effects and do not trigger the Shield Block reaction or reactions from armor property runes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.sTlptNnUX2eA0DIH]{Noqual} The stargut hydra's Golpes and abilities gain a +2 bonificador de estado to daño against criaturas with the ability to Lanzar un conjuro.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.6Z0v9Tsthm9hyzb3]{orichalcum} When the stargut hydra has only two heads remaining, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Acelerado}. It can use the extra action only to Zancada or Golpe.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.SXJRjw4R8m7NPDGc]{Siccatite} After the stargut hydra takes daño de fuego, it becomes superheated, gaining immunity to fire and weakness 10 to cold. While superheated, daño de frío can be used to cauterize a stump. After the stargut hydra takes daño de frío, it becomes chilled, gaining immunity to cold and weakness 10 to fire.

action->Hydra Regeneration.name: Hydra Regeneración
action->Hydra Regeneration.description: The stargut hydra has regeneration equal to 3 × the number of heads it has. If a hydra's body is missing any heads and the remaining stumps have not been cauterized, the hydra attempts a @Check[fortitude|immutable:true|dc:29] save after it regains Puntos de Golpe from regeneration. On a success, one uncauterized stump regrows two heads; on a critical success, two uncauterized stumps regrow into two heads each. The hydra can never grow more than double the number of heads it ordinarily has. The hydra's regeneration only fully deactivates if all its heads are severed and all stumps are cauterized, at which point it dies.

action->Head Regrowth.name: Head Regrowth
action->Head Regrowth.description:
A stargut hydra ordinarily has five heads. A criatura can attempt to sever one of the hydra's heads by specifically targeting it and dealing daño equal to the head's Puntos de Golpe. A head that is not completely severed returns to full Puntos de Golpe at the end of any criatura's turn. A hydra can regrow a severed head using hydra regeneration. A criatura can prevent this regrowth by dealing acid or daño de fuego to the stump, cauterizing it. Single-target acid or fire effects need to be targeted at a specific stump, but effects that deal daño de salpicadura or affect areas covering the hydra's whole space cauterize all stumps if they deal acid or daño de fuego. If the attack that severs a head deals any acid or daño de fuego, the stump is cauterized instantly. If all five heads are cauterized, the hydra dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.uZJOdounIHaFDC1t]{Efecto: Hydra Heads}

action->Reactive Heads.name: Reactive Heads
action->Reactive Heads.description: A stargut hydra gains an extra reaction per round for each of its heads beyond the first, which it can use only to make Reactive Golpes. It can't use more than 1 reaction on the same triggering action, even if a criatura leaves several squares within its reach, and the hydra must use a different head for each Reactive Golpe it makes. Siempre que one of the hydra's heads is severed, the hydra loses 1 of its extra reactions per round.

action->Vomit Meteorites.name: Vomit Meteorites
action->Vomit Meteorites.description: The stargut hydra lurches its entire body, spewing forth chunks of meteorite in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that deal @Damage[5d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] daño to all criaturas in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic|options:area-effect]). The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute, though a criatura can use an INTERACT action to clear one square of the rubble. The stargut hydra can't Vomit Meteorites for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Vomit Meteorites]]{1d4 rounds}.

Stonefish.name: Stonefish
Stonefish.publicNotes: Stonefish use their superior camouflage to lie in wait and devour small prey, becoming indistinguishable from the reefs they call home. Larger criaturas are also at risk, although mostly through accidental contact with the stonefish's spines and their agonizing venom.

action->Camouflage.name: Camuflaje

action->Defensive Spines.name: Defensive Spines
action->Defensive Spines.description: When a criatura moves into a space with one or more stonefish, that criatura takes @Damage[1d4[piercing]] daño and is exposed to stonefish venom.

Stony Bat.name: Stony Bat
Stony Bat.publicNotes:
Gorgons are a broad group of animals that share a few peculiar rasgos. All gorgons are covered in armored plates and breathe petrifying gases. Other than these features, gorgons can resemble almost any animal. While some gorgons may seem like less physically imposing criaturas, they should never be underestimated. Gorgons are canny hunters, and even a small puff of their breath can immobilize almost any prey.

Estos criaturas resemble chubby bats covered in small overlapping metal plates. They can't exhale enough petrifying gas to paralyze a normal-sized humanoid, but it's effective on their usual prey of insects and other small animals, which they petrify before consuming. However, stony bats have learned how to use their petrification gas to defend themselves against larger criaturas, freezing a limb or raining down pebbles of petrified water vapor.

Further, they can work together to bring down larger criaturas, petrifying and consuming them limb by limb.

Stony bats generally live in caves in large groups, though they frequently fly out in small numbers for hunting. They typically aren't aggressive against non-prey they encounter outside, though they're very protective of their caves. Oreads and others who don't fear petrification sometimes keep stony bats as pets.

action->Echolocation.name: Ecolocalizacion
action->Echolocation.description: El stony bat puede usar oido as un preciso sentido con el listed alcance.

action->Petrify Body Part.name: Petrify Body Part
action->Petrify Body Part.description:
The stony bat breathes a puff of petrifying gas onto an adjacent criatura, targeting a specific body part. El objetivo must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save or be partially petrified for 1 minute, with an effect varying with the body part targeted.

  • Face The criatura's face stiffens and a film of stone partially blocks its vision. It is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado}.
  • Hand One of the criatura's hands is petrified. It cannot Release items from that hand or use the hand for fine manipulation. Attack rolls with armas held in that hand take a –2 penalización de estado.
  • Leg A patch of the criatura's leg becomes inflexible and heavy. It takes a –10 penalización de estado to its Velocidad. If all of the criatura's legs become petrified in this way, the criatura's Velocidad is reduced down to 5 pies. At the GM's discretion, a criatura with movement that doesn't rely on legs, such as criaturas that Fly with wings, don't take a penalización to these other Velocidades.

action->Petrify Vapor.name: Petrify Vapor
action->Petrify Vapor.description: The stony bat breathes petrifying gas in a @Template[cone|distance:15], too thin to harm criaturas in the area. However, it petrifies ambient moisture, raining down a cascade of tiny stones onto any criaturas in the space directly below the cone. The falling rocks deal @Damage[4d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic|options:area-effect]). The stony bat can't use Petrify Vapor again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Petrify Vapor]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Stone Feast.name: Stone Feast
action->Stone Feast.description: The stony bat specifically targets petrified body parts, which it can consume, unlike flesh. The stony bat's jaws deal an extra 1d6 daño against a criatura that has been petrified, either partially or completely, and ignore the Hardness of petrified criaturas.

Stony Goat.name: Stony Goat
Stony Goat.publicNotes:
Stony goats diverge from their common cousins via their rock-like horns and unique appetites. Estos meek criaturas love to eat mineral ores, using teeth tougher than diamonds to grind down rocks and metals. The indigestible components, such as refined chunks of metal and precious stones, coagulate into a cud the goat regurgitates to further ruminate on. In emergency situations, stony goats can even drain nutrition from their cud. Estos properties might make stony goats excellent companions for miners and metalworkers; however, the beasts are quite rare and famously difficult to train.

Stony goats are jumpy criaturas with a prey animal's wide field of view and a strong SURVIVAL instinct. They also have a unique defense mechanism: when startled, stony goats temporarily petrify into solid stone, dissuading predators through inedibility. Este combination of weak nerves and tremendous climbing ability often leads to travelers discovering what appears to be a lone statue of a goat in an otherwise unoccupied mountainous area.

Keen observers can discern a stony goat's recent diet via the mineral flakes that form in the goat's horns, such as light silver streaks indicating a meal of dawnsilver ore. Collectors often hunt stony goats and display horns with rare properties. If a stony goat destroys its cud for emergency nutrition, its horns appear as solid chunks of the minerals it consumed for about an hour before reverting to their rock-like norm.

action->Cliff Climber.name: Cliff Climber
action->Cliff Climber.description: A stony goat can trot across the steepest cliffs. It doesn't need to attempt @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{CLIMB} checks to scale inclines, and it isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} while Climbing an incline. It ignora el terreno dificil causado por rocks, rubble, and uneven ground made of earth and stone.

action->Self-Petrify.name: Self-Petrify
action->Self-Petrify.description:
Desencadenante The stony goat gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} condition or takes more than 8 daño in a single hit

Efecto The stony goat turns to stone in self-defense. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrificado} condition for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. If the goat is damaged while it's petrified, it immediately heals by that amount by absorbing minerals from its cud, causing its cud to lose value equal to the amount of Puntos de Golpe restored (for instance, losing 5 gp worth of value to restore 5 Puntos de Golpe); if the goat's cud is reduced to 0 gp, it has the minerals fully drained from it, and the goat won't form more cud until it has eaten a sufficient quantity of rock and slept.

action->Overhead Leap.name: Overhead Leap
action->Overhead Leap.description: The stony goat @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leaps} up to 12 pies vertically and 20 pies horizontally; this movement no desencadena reacciones.

action->Shove and Run.name: Shove and Run
action->Shove and Run.description: The stony goat attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the nearest criatura and then Strides with a +20-pies bonificador de circunstancia to Velocidad.

action->Stone Bolt.name: Stone Bolt
action->Stone Bolt.description:
Desencadenante The stony goat loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrificado} condition

Efecto The stony goat's first instinct is to escape. It Strides with a +20 bonificador de circunstancia to its Velocidad.

Storm Snake.name: Storm Snake
Storm Snake.publicNotes:
Storm snakes are reclusive criaturas only seen in the wild during intense storms. The metallic scales that cover their bodies attract and absorb nearby lightning strikes, suffusing the criaturas with a halo of blue or white light. Because storm snakes are most often sighted in solitude and disappear without a trace as soon as a storm recedes, a lot of folklore across Golarion considers them to be the emissaries of storm deities and harbingers of disaster.

Before live clutches of storm snake young were first discovered, it was hypothesized that the criaturas were made of mist and vapor; many assumed them to be illusory shapes within the clouds themselves or fleeting dragon sightings. New zoological research has found, however, that storm snakes are actually a distant cousin of dragons. Raised on mountaintops in small broods, storm snakes have underdeveloped limbs and lack any form of wing. Instead, they expand and contract their metallic scales to capture the static electricity in wind currents, which keeps them aloft during high winds and storms.

Research has also shed light on the diet of these naturally shy criaturas. Rather than consuming electricity, as many who'd observed them in storms believed, storm snakes are herbivorous, enjoying most varieties of grasses, plants, or tree leaves. Este diet, considered alongside their flight patterns during thunderstorms, has been theorized to be a form of symbiosis; after all, any lightning strikes absorbed by a storm snake during a storm can't daño the plant growth below. Additionally, safely discharged electricity from a storm snake has been observed to stimulate growth in a wide variety of flora, all while having no adverse affects on the plants' palatability or nutritional benefits. Many farmers have tried in vain to capture, tame, or otherwise attract storm snakes to their fields to invigorate their crops during tough times, though few have succeeded.

action->Static Shock.name: Static Shock
action->Static Shock.description:
Desencadenante A criatura touches the storm snake or damages it with an unarmed melee attack or non-reach melee arma

Efecto The triggering enemigo is shocked for @Damage[2d8[electricity]] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:19|basic] save). On a failed save, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}.

action->Lightning Strike.name: Lightning Golpe
action->Lightning Strike.description: The storm snake redirects the lightning it has absorbed from storms, dealing @Damage[2d10[electricity]] daño to a single target within 20 pies (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] save). On a failure, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Deslumbrado} until the end of its next turn.

action->Static Field.name: Static Field
action->Static Field.description:
The storm snake gathers all static electricity in the area before releasing it in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] that deals @Damage[3d12[electricity]|options:area-damage] daño to all non-plant criaturas (@Check[reflex|dc:19|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save) and grants plant criaturas 5 Puntos de Golpe temporales that last for 1 minute. Plant life in the area begins to grow significantly faster than the average for plants of their genus; in forests, fields, or otherwise floral locations, this immediately transforms the area into non-magical difficult terrain. The storm snake can't use Static field again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Static Field]]{1d4 rounds}.

Taldan Cave Squirrel.name: Taldan Cave Squirrel
Taldan Cave Squirrel.publicNotes:
Taldan cave squirrels, also known as tauhotis, are a curious cousin of the much smaller common ground squirrel, found anywhere with large, grassy flatlands. The criaturas burrow underground, forming cave systems tall enough for giants in astonishingly little time. Once the caves are excavated, the squirrels turn their attention toward the largest quantities of gems or metals they can find—including those in the ground floors and vaults of nearby buildings. Nothing is off-limits, and no effort is too large when these squirrels go gem hunting.

Cave squirrels' desire for these precious stones and ores arises not from greed, but rather productivity. After returning to the cave system, cheek pouches full of treasure, the males deposit the stolen goods before the females, who lick and spit on the piles of gems and metals to form them into structural pillars. Given the cave squirrels' tireless work habits, these pillars can solidify in a matter of hours, easily displacing existing stone and soil. Many an Opparan groundskeeper has stepped outside after a lovely teatime to find months of work undone in a scene of utter, glittering chaos. Architects throughout history have attempted to recreate or imitate these gleaming pillars; however, they rarely succeeded, for they often lacked a certain unpredictable pragmatism the cave squirrels seem to effortlessly achieve.

When threatened, cave squirrels will let out a high-pitched scream to warn their colony. They can spit out any food or building materials in their cheek pouches with deadly speeds at attackers.

action->Studded Cheeks.name: Studded Cheeks
action->Studded Cheeks.description: El cave squirrel puede store up a six gems en su cheeks. It typically begins combat con todos six, y ello pierde un gem cada time ello usa gem spit.

action->Defensive Scream.name: Defensive Scream
action->Defensive Scream.description:
Desencadenante The cave squirrel rolls initiative or has taken daño before initiative

Efecto The cave squirrel lets out an ear-piercing shriek, alerting any other cave squirrels in the area to its plight. It uses Screaming Force.

action->Concussive Gem.name: Concussive Gem
action->Concussive Gem.description: On a critical hit on a gem spit Golpe, el objetivo must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Aturdido 1}.

action->Forage for Gems.name: Forage for Gems
action->Forage for Gems.description: The cave squirrel dives underground in search of gems. The cave squirrel Burrows up to its Velocidad. It must end its movement back on the surface. During its burrow, it happens upon [[/gmr 1d4 #Gems]] cheap gems (such as salt or quartz), which it stuffs in its cheeks, up to its maximum of 6.

action->Natural Velocidad.name: Natural Velocidad
action->Natural Velocidad.description: A cave squirrel isn't affected by difficult terrain from earth or stone.

action->Screaming Force.name: Screaming Force
action->Screaming Force.description: The cave squirrel lets out a terrible scream. Non–cave squirrel criaturas within @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30 pies} must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save or take @Damage[2d10[sonic]] daño. On a critical failure, a criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Ensordecido} for 1 minute. The cave squirrel can't use Screaming Force again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge Screaming Force]]{1d4 rounds}.

Tardigrade Swarm.name: Tardigrade Swarm
Tardigrade Swarm.publicNotes: Tardigrades grow no larger than el width de un hair, but cuando su riverside environments son exposed a heightened levels de magia, these eight-legged omnivores puede grow a tremendous sizes.

action->Eyespots.name: Eyespots
action->Eyespots.description: A tardigrade swarm can't see anything beyond 30 pies.

action->Tun Marbles.name: Tun Marbles
action->Tun Marbles.description: As the tardigrade swarm is damaged, the bodies of those that enter a tun state make the ground treacherous. When the tardigrade swarm drops below 70 Puntos de Golpe, the space they occupy is considered difficult terrain.

action->Stylets.name: Stylets
action->Stylets.description: Each enemigo in the swarm's space takes @Damage[4d8[piercing]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save). Las criaturas that fail their save become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 1} or increase their drained condition by one, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drenado 4}.

Therizinosaurus.name: Therizinosaurus
Therizinosaurus.publicNotes: At first glance, the therizinosaurus, with its rotund, feathered body and bird-like beak, strikes many observers as almost comical. Este impression tends to quickly fade at the sight of the criatura's claws, six wicked, scythelike blades capable of disemboweling a foe with a single well-placed slash. Despite their intimidating appearance, these enormous claws are used primarily to separate tasty leaves and branches from the tops of the tall trees upon which the therizinosaurus feeds. Nonetheless, travelers through a therizinosaurus's territory are wisely advised to give the criatura a wide berth, less they wind up on the wrong end of its notoriously foul temper.

Tyrafdir.name: Tyrafdir
Tyrafdir.publicNotes:
The most commonly seen hydra famously has five heads that it uses in unison to attack prey or assailants. Scattered across the Inner Sea region are more fantastical breeds of the beast, each with their own curious evolution and hunting behavior.

The process of sapient species finding kinship with those who are less self-aware can be observed easily throughout the natural world. Humanoids keep dogs, kobolds care for reptiles, and so on. More terrifying, as it is on a grander scale, linnorms with a strong attachment to the First World sometimes keep mutated hydras as pets and guards. Known to Ulfens as tyrafdirs, these beasts have the unique ability to create illusory doubles from the ruined stumps of their necks. Estos serpentine guardians serve as strong protectors in the Land of the Linnorm Kings, where their fey-warped physiology deters many a would-be monarch from claiming their maestro's head. The domestication of tyrafdirs by especially powerful spellcasters to serve as guardians has been known to take place, often combined with magical traps that attack the intruder's mind.

action->Hydra Regeneration.name: Hydra Regeneración
action->Hydra Regeneration.description:
On a failure the tyrafdir grows two illusory heads.

The hydra has regeneration equal to 3 × the number of heads it has. If a hydra's body is missing any heads and the remaining stumps have not been cauterized, the hydra attempts a @Check[fortitude|immutable:true|dc:31] save after it regains Puntos de Golpe from regeneration. On a success, one uncauterized stump regrows two heads; on a critical success, two uncauterized stumps regrow into two heads each. The hydra can never grow more than double the number of heads it ordinarily has. The hydra's regeneration only fully deactivates if all its heads are severed and all stumps are cauterized, at which point it dies.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Regeneración]

action->Deceptive Heads.name: Deceptive Heads
action->Deceptive Heads.description:
A tyrafdir is cunning, if unintelligent, using illusions of regrown heads to confuse and harry opponents. When a tyrafdir fails, but does not critically fail, its Fortitude save to regrow a head, a phantasm materializes to mimic the regrowth. Este creates two deceptive heads that function differently than real heads. The tyrafdir gains a deceptive jaws Golpe as long as it has at least one deceptive head. Any criatura that attacks a deceptive head or uses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve the illusion (@Check[will|dc:27] save).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.NZ3MrmXkmfQuJp7S]{Efecto: Deceptive Heads}

action->Deceptive Regrowth.name: Deceptive Regrowth

A tyrafdir ordinarily has six heads. A criatura can attempt to sever one of the tyrafdir's heads by specifically targeting it and dealing daño equal to the head's Puntos de Golpe. A head that is not completely severed returns to full Puntos de Golpe at the end of any criatura's turn. A tyrafdir can regrow a severed head using Hydra Regeneración. A criatura can prevent this regrowth by dealing daño de fuego to the stump, cauterizing it. Single-target fire effects need to be targeted at a specific stump, but effects that deal daño de salpicadura or affect areas covering the hydra's whole space cauterize all stumps if they deal daño de fuego. If the attack that severs a head deals any daño de fuego or is dealt by a cold-iron arma, the stump is cauterized instantly. If all six heads are cauterized, the hydra dies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.uZJOdounIHaFDC1t]{Efecto: Hydra Heads}

It can't use more than 1 reaction on the same triggering action, even if a criatura leaves several squares within its reach, and the hydra must use a different head for each Reactive Golpe it makes. Siempre que one of the hydra's heads is severed, the hydra loses 1 of its extra reactions per round.

Vibrant Pup Swarm.name: Vibrant Pup Swarm
Vibrant Pup Swarm.publicNotes:
Estos tenacious little rodents travel in massive swarms across the desert, using the sun both as shield and sword during their long marches. Unlike other rodents, vibrant pups are eusocial, causing them to behave more like insects than other rodents. Only the queen can reproduce, and is fiercely protected for that reason. Este social structure enables them to viciously attack and act as a single unit. Each of the pups also have specific roles within the family and the swarm. The worker pups gather and dig while in a den, but will act as a shield to protect the more valuable fighter pups while swarming.

Vibrant pups spend most of their lives underground, digging out elaborate tunnels in search for food. However, in the harsh deserts of Thuvia, food can be scarce. A family of vibrant pups will abandon their dens and set out on harsh multiday journeys in search of land that can sustain the queen long enough to have another litter of pups. Estos journeys can happen up to three times a year, following seasonal changes in resources. Outside of these local migrations, swarms will leave their dens only to repel a massive threat to the queen.

Vibrant pups have unusual and beautiful anatomical features. Their skin, while soft, is extremely reflective, which serves a dual purpose for the rodents since it can both reflect the harsh sun away to better thermoregulate as well as focus those rays toward threats, especially when multiple pups work in unison. The glinting of a pup swarm in migration can be seen from afar—rather than inviting challenges, this obvious display signals would-be predators to steer clear.

As of late, their reflective, soft skin has become quite fashionable in wealthy circles. While hunting such small criaturas for their pelts is extremely impractical and dangerous, the high price tag has led to more frequent hunts. While these rodents do serve a unique ecological niche, many farmers are more than happy to rid their fields of these voracious eaters and will often point out nearby hives to local hunters.

Virtuosic Lyrebird.name: Virtuosic Lyrebird
Virtuosic Lyrebird.publicNotes:
Virtuosic lyrebirds present an excellent case study in how specialty-bred animals can escape captivity and become pests. A small team of apprentice mages established the original virtuosic lyrebirds as part of their graduation thesis, in an attempt to create a familiar that could better aid in spellcasting. The vocal mimicry of these birds did indeed allow them to harmonize with their bonded spellcaster; however, initial progress was slow, and the impatient students chose to hastily elevate the birds' abilities before their thesis deadline using experimental magic. Unfortunately, the specimens' newfound vocal mimicry was so supreme that they could mimic conjuro incantations as easily as any other sound they heard. The virtuosic lyrebirds soon vaporized, teleported out of, or befuddled their keepers into opening their cages, escaping into the wild and flourishing.

Virtuosic lyrebirds use their spellcasting abilities mostly to play pranks and alleviate boredom. They tend to travel in pairs, but when these pairs congregate into larger flocks, their mischief and fun can quickly turn dangerous.

  • The conjuro gains a +2 bonificador de estado to daño per conjuro rank.
  • One target of the conjuro takes a –2 penalización de estado to saves against the conjuro.

Efecto The virtuosic lyrebird learns the conjuro enough to mimic and cast it this turn, using as many actions as the original conjuro took.

action->Spellsong Casting.name: Spellsong Casting
action->Spellsong Casting.description: The virtuosic lyrebird's exquisite vocal control lets it cast conjuros purely through its song. While it must be able to vocalize to Lanzar un conjuro, it doesn't need to gesture, removing the manipulate rasgo from any conjuro that it casts. If it Casts a Spell with the linguistic rasgo (usually with its Spell Mimicry), it can Cast that Spell in Common, even though the bird doesn't truly understand the language.

A Vengeful Present

Weremoose.name: Weremoose
Weremoose.publicNotes:
Werecreatures are humanoids who transform into animals and animal-humanoid hybrids under the light of the full moon. The fate of these shapechanging criaturas derives from an ancient primal curse that they can, in turn, transmit through their own bites. The stat blocks in this section reflect werecreatures in their hybrid forms.

A weremoose's tendencies toward stubbornness and a grumpy attitude make it difficult for them to get along with others. Most often, they live as hunters or hermits, taking in the peace of their natural surroundings. If their territory is invaded, they don't hide or retreat but are unlikely to attack. If someone else starts the fight, though, a weremoose retaliates without mercy.
